description: The rules of the machine, in plain words. XP is the global score of work actually done. CT is the local score, the only place reputation lives. L is fully automatic. And the till turns L times XP into EP, the discount itself. Vic plays skeptic: sounds utopian, sounds like free money. Ron answers with the three load-bearing points: the reversed economy, recaptured extraction, and the honest density condition. Part 3 of The Engine in Plain Words.
keywords: Extropy Engine, XP, CT, tokenomics, entropy economics, open source economy, value redefined, proof of work, Vic and Ron, podcast
